digest.component_or_area: structured output baseline evaluation harness in CI
propositions: Live LLM measurement harness must capture raw model outputs and score deterministically across provider-model cells (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock) for current vs sentinel directive variants to measure before/after raw-output distribution changes.
CI workflow must enforce a predeclared per-run call budget (default 300 calls) before any network call is constructed, and refuse to start if the matrix would exceed the cap.
Cells missing API credentials must be recorded as 'unmeasured' and skipped without failing the job, verified by unit tests on the skip logic.

Scorer unit tests must reproduce exact golden counts on committed E2 reply fixtures, validating parse-success rates under current and new parsers and layout-class distributions (prose, fenced, multi-object, quoted-JSON).

Workflow job must be manually triggered (workflow_dispatch) with per-provider secret scoping copied from external-integration.yml, and artifact bundle (raw replies + before/after score table) must be uploaded for operator attestation.
